This Android will be the brain of the telescope. This is all it needs:
Turn on OTG if your phone has it
Some phones (Huawei, Honor, some Xiaomi…) have an “OTG” switch in Settings. Turn it on so the USB cable works. Most phones do not need it.
Plug the cable into the telescope

USB serial cable (PL2303, FTDI, CP210x, CH34x) to the NexStar hand control port, with an OTG adapter to the phone. Switch the telescope on. The app opens by itself: accept the USB permission and tick “use by default”.
Location: the GPS gives your place and the exact time to point. Camera (optional): to take and stack pictures. Notifications: to see the state with the screen off.
Do not let the system close it
StarBridge keeps working with the screen off. Some brands close background apps: allow the battery exception.
Connect your iPhone or another phone
Put both on the same WiFi (for example the iPhone hotspot) and scan the QR on this screen with the camera. You can also use this same phone as the controller.
No USB debugging, no developer options, no internet, no accounts.
